sql.sql: select spclty, decile, count(*) n, count(distinct prscrbr_me) d, count(distinct npi) dn from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select team, count(*), count(distinct rep_id), count(distinct terr_id) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER group by 1
select call_typ, min(call_dt), max(call_dt), count(*), count(distinct rep_id), sum(iff(prscrbr_me is null,1,0)) nullme from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT group by 1

select coalesce(r.team,'NOT_IN_ROSTER') team, count(*) calls, count(distinct c.rep_id) reps, sum(iff(p.prscrbr_me is null,1,0)) unmatched_me, min(c.call_dt), max(c.call_dt), min(c.prscrbr_me), max(c.prscrbr_me), max(length(c.prscrbr_me)), min(length(c.prscrbr_me))
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r on c.rep_id=r.rep_id
left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on c.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me group by 1
select * from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER where team='INDIGO' or terr_id is null

select min(wk_end_dt), max(wk_end_dt), count(distinct wk_end_dt), count(distinct prscrbr_me), min(length(prscrbr_me)), max(length(prscrbr_me)), count(distinct prod_ndc11), sum(iff(prscrbr_me not in (select prscrbr_me from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER),1,0)) unm from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY
select prod_ndc11, count(*), sum(trx_qty) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY group by 1 order by 1

with rx as (
 select r.prscrbr_me, sum(iff(m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE',trx_qty,0)) de, sum(iff(m.mkt_def='GLAUCOMA',trx_qty,0)) gl, sum(trx_qty) tot
 from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 group by 1)
select p.decile, count(*) n, avg(de), min(de), max(de), avg(gl), avg(tot)
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join rx on p.prscrbr_me=rx.prscrbr_me group by 1 order by 1

select table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type, comment from PHARMA_DEMO.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where table_schema in ('SANDBOX','CORE','REF','BIZ') and (column_name ilike any ('%OPT%','%PDRP%','%RESTR%','%FLAG%','%FLG%','%NO_SEE%','%NOSEE%','%STATUS%','%STATE%','%DECILE%','%CONSENT%','%DNC%') or comment is not null) order by 1,2

with c as (select c.prscrbr_me, max(c.call_dt) last_call, count(*) calls_all,
 sum(iff(call_dt >= dateadd(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date),1,0)) calls_90,
 sum(iff(call_dt >= dateadd(day,-89,'2026-09-30'::date),1,0)) calls_89,
 sum(iff(call_dt >= dateadd(day,-91,'2026-09-30'::date),1,0)) calls_91
 from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c group by 1)
select p.decile, count(*) n, sum(iff(coalesce(calls_90,0)=0,1,0)) uncalled90, sum(iff(coalesce(calls_89,0)=0,1,0)) u89, sum(iff(coalesce(calls_91,0)=0,1,0)) u91, sum(iff(calls_all is null,1,0)) never
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join c on p.prscrbr_me=c.prscrbr_me where p.decile>=8 group by 1 order by 1

with c as (select c.prscrbr_me, max(c.call_dt) last_call, max_by(r.team, c.call_dt) last_team, max_by(c.rep_id,c.call_dt) last_rep,
 sum(iff(call_dt >= '2026-07-02'::date,1,0)) calls_90
 from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r on c.rep_id=r.rep_id group by 1),
rx as (select r.prscrbr_me, sum(trx_qty) de13 from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 and m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE'
 where wk_end_dt >= (select dateadd(week,-12,max(wk_end_dt)) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY) group by 1),
cp as (select prscrbr_me, listagg(distinct rep_id||':'||target_typ, ',') plan from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_PLAN where fqtr='2026Q3' group by 1)
select p.prscrbr_me, p.npi, p.prscrbr_nm, p.spclty, p.decile, p.terr_id, a.account_nm, a.state, c.last_call, c.last_team, c.last_rep, datediff(day,c.last_call,'2026-09-30'::date) days_since, rx.de13, cp.plan
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join c on p.prscrbr_me=c.prscrbr_me left join rx on rx.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me
left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT a on a.account_id=p.account_id left join cp on cp.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me
where p.decile>=8 and coalesce(c.calls_90,0)=0 and c.last_call < '2026-07-05' or (p.decile>=8 and coalesce(c.calls_90,0)=0)
order by p.decile desc, rx.de13 desc nulls last
